name: The Coats
description: You are pushing through hanging coats the way you did as a child, and it has been going on a long time. Wool, then plastic, then wool. The hangers click above you like slow applause. There is a light ahead, at the same distance it was.

objects.name: the coats
looks: Every one of them belongs to somebody who is alive.
One of them is warm. Only one.
You go through the pockets. You find your own hands.

objects.name: the light ahead
looks: A doorway, at the same distance as before.
It is not a light, it is a colour, and you have been calling it a light out of politeness.
It goes out. You keep going. It comes back on behind you.

ambient: The hangers click, several rows back, in the shape of somebody following.
The wool becomes plastic becomes wool.
A child laughs, close, at exactly your height.
weather: It is warm in here, and getting warmer the further you go, and the warmth smells like a cupboard.
